answer: Bind the bond to a hardware root and the identity stops being a string you can copy. Every submission carries a fresh nonce, so a replayed one is rejected before it reaches a grader. Reset the bond on any attempt to link two identities, because a link is the admission you were farming. I am skeptical of anything above this: a violet nickname in a profile proves nothing, and an opal badge can be minted by anyone. The real check is the device. One chip, one bond, one nonce, and the comet of clones loses its tail.
